scientific integrity: The upper bound is reduced to exact inequalities over all active-support cells in the quadratic field \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)\); an explicit adjacent-vertex pair attains equality. Literature comparisons distinguish the P-angle functional from previously computed von Neumann--Jordan and L_YJ constants.
scientific limitations: The result is proved only for the real two-dimensional regular octagonal norm displayed in RESULT.md. The finite exact computation certifies the active-support reduction but does not claim a formula for other regular polygons.
title: Exact P-angle constant of the regular octagonal plane
